name: TJAC Data Center Isaac Timoteo Oliveira Junior
notes: State judiciary data center in Rio Branco; official TJAC source says it has 880 TB storage capacity plus redundancy for cooling, generators and equipment.

name: Sem Fronteiras Data Center
notes: Local ISP data center in Acre offering colocation, server hosting/management and cloud storage; reported investment above R$5 million.

name: Acesso10 Telecom Maceio Data Center
notes: Directory and PeeringDB evidence identify an Acesso10 data center/facility in Maceio, with colocation/connectivity services; no public MW figure found.

name: SJAP New Data Center
notes: Official SJAP source says the winning contractor visited the Macapa site for construction of a new pilot data center for the Federal Justice institution.

name: ClickIP Data Centers Manaus
notes: Commercial TIA-942-C Rated 3 data center in Manaus; reported 49 racks, 500 kVA total capacity and 240 kW dedicated to IT space.

name: PRODAM Amazonas Data Center
notes: Official PRODAM page lists data center services in Manaus for government/enterprise digital infrastructure; no public MW figure found.

name: Renova Energia Alto Sertao III Wind Farm Data Center
notes: Reported 80 MW data center project at Renova Energia's Alto Sertao III wind complex in Igapora, Bahia; Guardian also references Igapora among Brazil data center project locations with drought concerns.

name: Atlantic Data Centers Salvador Project
notes: BNamericas reported Um Telecom intended to submit a financing project for a second data center in Salvador, Bahia; DCD confirms Um Telecom created Atlantic Data Centers as its data center unit.

name: Ascenty Fortaleza 1
notes: Operator page lists Fortaleza 1 in Ceara with 10 MW total power, 97,000 sq ft total area, TR3 certification, dedicated substation and carrier-neutral service.

name: Digital Realty Fortaleza FTZ01
notes: Digital Realty lists Fortaleza FTZ01 in Maracanau, Ceara, with 93,500 sq ft / 8,700 sq m of colocation space and carrier-neutral connectivity near submarine cable landing infrastructure.

name: AngoNAP Fortaleza
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III-designed Angola Cables data center in Fortaleza serving Brazil-Latin America-Africa connectivity; no MW figure found in public sources.

name: Angola Cables Second Fortaleza Data Center
notes: DCD reported a second Fortaleza data center adjacent to AngoNAP, 960 sq m, with investment up to R$400 million / US$80 million and works expected to finish in 2025.

name: TikTok / ByteDance Caucaia-Pecem Data Center
developer: ByteDance / TikTok with Casa dos Ventos / Omnia
notes: Reported first TikTok Latin America data center near Fortaleza/Caucaia-Pecem, with 300 MW capacity and wind-power supply; project has faced Indigenous/community and water-use concerns.

name: Serpro Brasilia Data Center at Biotic
notes: Serpro plans a 12 MW Brasilia data center at Biotic technology park to support AI workloads, tax reform systems and government cloud expansion.

name: Elea BSB1 Brasilia
notes: Operator page lists BSB1 in Brasilia with 4 MW+ IT capacity and 10+ carriers; forms a major Midwest colocation hub with BSB2.

name: Elea BSB2 Brasilia
notes: Elea/RNP source says BSB2 is a Tier III design-certified Brasilia colocation data center using 100% renewable energy, with 4.5 MW IT capacity and 10+ carriers.

name: Telebras Brasilia Data Center
notes: Serpro was reported to be negotiating to use Telebras' existing data center in Brasilia as part of a third sovereign cloud zone; no MW figure found.

name: Prodest Second State Data Center
developer: Prodest / Governo do Estado do Espirito Santo
notes: Official state source says Prodest's second state data center will be a modular redundant facility in Carapina, Serra, under ES Mais Inteligente; implementation estimated for August 2028.

name: Prodest First State Data Center Modernization
developer: Prodest / Governo do Estado do Espirito Santo
notes: Official Prodest article says the state ICT institute is investing in modernization and expansion of the first state data center alongside the new second data center project.

name: VIX Data Center
notes: Directory evidence identifies VIX Data Center / ConectJa in Cariacica-Vitoria, described as an Espirito Santo data center with colocation/cloud/managed services; no MW figure found.

name: Everest Digital Data Center Goiania
notes: Everest/Soluti data center in Goiania; operator says it is the first Tier III MSP data center in the Center-West and has its own Goiania data center, while DCD reports a 4,500 sq m LEED Gold site.

name: ZPE Maranhao Green Data Center / ZPE Digital
notes: Official investment-promotion pages say a green data center project for ZPE Maranhao is in study/planning, focused on green technology and AI applications, with a protocol of intent and environmental licensing in progress.

name: Wiki Telecom Sao Luis Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists one Wiki Telecom data center in Sao Luis, Maranhao; R&M LinkedIn post says Wiki set up its own data center at Mocelin Tower in Sao Luis in 2020.

name: Maxx Tier 3 Data Center Maranhao
notes: Local news reports Maxx is structuring an enterprise as the first Tier 3 data center in Maranhao, with redundancy for power and cooling; no MW figure found.
